description: Angular component for selecting Material icons, including dialog and popover interactions, form control integration, and customization options.

classes.name: MaterialIconSelectComponent
classes.description: Angular component for selecting and managing Material icons with form control and popover support.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and subscribes to value changes to update the model.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form control.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the current icon value in the form control.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the internal model and propagates change if value differs.

methods.name: openIconDialog
methods.description: Opens icon picker dialog and updates icon based on user selection.

methods.name: openIconPopup
methods.description: Displays icon selection popover triggered by button, updates icon on selection.
